description: Open r-enc-link-enc-mdb-pwd read/write shared with ';pwd=secret1'; update rows 1, 32 and 64 (start, middle, end) with 3,000-character memos, insert a row, delete a range, bulk-insert a copy of the table (index split), then close. The database bytes before and after are kept; the file is reopened with the password and counted.

args.text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(LEN(M)) AS LM, MAX(ID) AS MX FROM T
SELECT K, TID FROM U ORDER BY K

UPDATE T SET S = 'edited-first', M = '' WHERE ID = 1

UPDATE T SET S = 'edited-middle', M = '' WHERE ID = 32

UPDATE T SET S = 'edited-last', M = '' WHERE ID = 64

INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) VALUES (100, 'inserted', '')
DELETE FROM T WHERE ID BETWEEN 10 AND 20
INSERT INTO T (ID, S, M) SELECT ID + 1000, 'z' & ID, M FROM T
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(LEN(M)) AS LM, MAX(ID) AS MX FROM T
SELECT K, TID FROM U ORDER BY K
